snippets.title: Inspect a board
snippets.description: Replace the request with a board inventory: footprints, pads, vias, holes and outline, confirmed against KiCad's statistics.

board.label: Board file (.kicad_pcb)
board.description: Absolute path to a saved KiCad board. A sibling .kicad_pro and .kicad_dru with the same name are captured with it.

snippets.requires: Requires a saved .kicad_pcb (KiCad 8.0-10.0, two copper layers) and a configured KiCad 10.0 kicad-cli when running.

snippets.title: Design rule check
snippets.description: Replace the request with a KiCad DRC that accepts no errors or unconnected items and the chosen number of warnings.

board.label: Board file (.kicad_pcb)

maximumWarnings.label: Maximum DRC warnings
maximumWarnings.description: Largest acceptable number of warning-severity findings; more fails the run with DRC_VIOLATIONS.

snippets.title: Excellon drill files
